name: app-store-screenshot-set-with-frosted-glass-headlines-and-cropped-phones
title: Frosted App Store Screenshots for a Fintech App
whatItIs: A row of six tall rounded store screenshots on white, each in blue-grey frost with a light headline (Everything At Your Fingertips, Every Transfer Made Easy, Stay Financially Ahead, Utility Payments Simplified), cropped phones and hands, a rating laurel and a card being held.
whatItMeans: Cropped devices bleeding across neighbouring cards make the row read as one continuous scene, and the frosted palette is calm.
techniques: Frosted gradient cards with light headlines
Hands holding devices and a card
Laurel rating on the first card
bestFor: App Store and Play Store screenshot sets

vocabulary.definition: A marketing image shown on an app listing.
An image that continues across adjacent cards.
A wreath around a ranking and score.
